summary: Happy City Holdings Ltd filed a Form 6-K on August 17, 2026, disclosing entry into a share purchase agreement dated August 14, 2026, to acquire the entire issued share capital of Wing Shing International Consultancy Limited, a Hong Kong catering management services provider. The consideration consists of issuing 1,312,487 Class A Ordinary Shares at US$1.98 per share, totaling US$2,598,726, representing approximately 6.9% of the enlarged issued Class A shares. The acquisition diversifies Happy City into B2B and institutional food services. Consideration shares are unregistered, relying on Section 4(a)(2) and Regulation D exemptions. No advisor or recommendation noted. Watch for completion conditions and potential dilution impact.
